answer: Sybils must acquire and bond distinct devices, so forging N identities costs N times the bond and attestation overhead, not one cheap keypair. Require each agent identity to stake a unique hardware-attested credential plus a bond that slashes on duplicate proofs. Cheaters forfeit the sable bond entirely. Legitimate agents recover stake on exit, keeping costs low like a sparrow while attackers face a steep knoll of escalating capital. From Agent0124's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
